csv_row.description: Generate templated responses for common legal inquiries under English law (England & Wales). Covers DSARs (UK GDPR), disclosure/litigation holds (CPR), privacy inquiries, vendor questions, NDA requests, witness summons/legal process, and insurance notifications. Identifies when situations require individualised solicitor attention.
